home.metaDescription: Scollarly helps African students find and apply to Indian universities. Free for students, with a team that answers on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Study in India from Africa
hero.subtitle: We connect African students with Indian universities and help with every step, from results to arrival.

home.freeForStudents: Our help is free for students.
home.universitiesEmpty: Our universities are being added. Message us on WhatsApp and we will suggest one that fits your results.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Pages you have already opened still work. Reconnect to see the rest.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in to follow your application, or to work as Scollarly staff.
signIn.noGoogle: No Google account? You can still apply and message us on WhatsApp.
signIn.offline: You need a connection to sign in.
signIn.errorCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
signIn.errorFailed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.
signIn.errorUnavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Please try again in a moment.

signOut.failed: We could not sign you out.

invite.title: You were invited as an admin
invite.forEmail: This invite is for {email}. Sign in with that Google account.
invite.unusable: This invite can't be used. Ask the owner for a new one.
invite.wrongAccount: This invite can't be used with the Google account you signed in with. Sign in with {email}, or ask the owner for a new invite.
invite.unavailable: We could not check the invite. Please try again.

twoFactor.unavailable: We could not load this page. Please try again.
twoFactor.notOwner: This page is for the owner only.
twoFactor.enrolIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.scanAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.secretLabel: Or type this key into the app
twoFactor.codesBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.errorUsed: That code was already used. Wait for the next one.
twoFactor.errorLocked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
twoFactor.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.offline: You are offline. Admin pages need a connection.

common.error: We could not load this page.

stepUp.errorLocked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
stepUp.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.soon: Leads, content and analytics arrive in the next stages.

profile.title: My profile
profile.errorName: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
profile.errorGeneric: We could not save. Please try again.

team.title: Team
team.inviteBody: They must sign in with this exact Google email. No email is sent: you copy the link and send it yourself, for example on WhatsApp.
team.linkBody: Copy this link and send it. It works once and expires in 7 days. It is shown only now.
team.removeBody: {count, plural, =0 {They hold no leads.} one {They hold 1 lead, which will return to the unassigned pool.} other {They hold # leads, which will return to the unassigned pool.}} They will be signed out at once.
team.errorAlreadyStaff: That person is already on the team.
team.errorConflict: An invite was just created for that email. Reload the page.
team.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who changed what. Times are in West Africa Time (WAT). This list cannot be edited.
audit.errorFilters: Check the dates: they must be real days, with the start before the end.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorOn: On. Your authenticator app is required at every sign-in.
security.regenerateBody: The old codes stop working at once.
security.newCodesBody: Each code signs you in once. They are shown only now.

universities.metaDescription: Indian universities Scollarly works with: location, accreditation and fees where confirmed.
universities.title: Universities
universities.intro: Indian universities we work with. Open one to see its programmes, fees and campus.
universities.noMatch: No university matches. Clear the search or a filter.
universities.empty: Our universities are being added. Message us on WhatsApp and we will suggest one that fits your results.

university.feeDisclaimer: Fees are set by the university and can change. We confirm them with the university before you pay anything.
university.feesTbc: Fees to be confirmed. Ask us and we will check with the university.
university.nextHeading: Ready to take the next step?

embed.needsConnection: Needs a connection. Try again when you are online.
embed.dataNotice: The tour is loaded from the university's own site and may use a lot of mobile data.

fees.metaDescription: University fees in USD or INR, shown only when confirmed. Others: contact us.
fees.title: Fees
fees.intro: Fee ranges for universities where we have confirmed them. Each amount shows its currency and when it was last updated.
fees.disclaimer: Fees are set by the universities and can change. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.
fees.empty: Fees will appear here once the universities are added.

tours.metaDescription: Videos and 360° tours of partner campuses. Nothing loads until you tap.
tours.title: Campus tours
tours.intro: See the campuses before you decide. Videos and tours load only when you tap them, so they use no data until then.
tours.empty: Campus tours will appear here once the universities are added.

contact.intro: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp.

contact.otherPending: More contact details will be published here soon.

privacy.metaDescription: How Scollarly handles your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.pending: Our full privacy notice is being finalised. This is a summary of how we handle your data.

summary.collect: When you apply we keep your name, WhatsApp number, country, results and chosen programmes. We keep your email only if you give it.
summary.use: We use them only to advise you, answer you on WhatsApp and help with your application.
summary.share: We share your details with a university only for your application and only when you agree.
summary.rights: You can ask us to send you your data or erase it, by WhatsApp or from your account.

terms.metaDescription: The terms for using the Scollarly website.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.pending: Our full terms are being finalised. This is a summary.

summary.free: Scollarly's help is free for students. We never ask students to pay us.
summary.accuracy: University information can change. Check fees and dates with us before you decide.
summary.contact: Questions about these terms: contact us on WhatsApp.

page.metaDescription: Tell us your results and the programmes you like. We save it on your phone and message you on WhatsApp.

fields.name: Your full name
fields.whatsappHelp: Start with your country code, for example +237 for Cameroon, then your number.
fields.emailHelp: Only if you want us to be able to write to you by email.
fields.resultsHelp: Add each subject with its grade. You can also send them to us on WhatsApp later.
fields.subject: Subject

programmes.title: Programmes you like
programmes.help: Choose at least 3. The first is your first choice; you can change the order.

consent.text: I have read the {link} and I agree that Scollarly may contact me about my application.

quick.title: Chat with us on WhatsApp
quick.intro: Tell us who you are and we will open the chat. We keep this so we can answer you.

apply.title: Start your application
apply.intro: A few details and your programme choices. It is saved on your phone first, so nothing is lost if your signal drops.
apply.confirmRemove: Remove this saved application from your phone?
apply.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. You can message us on WhatsApp instead.
apply.soon: Applications will open here soon. In the meantime, message us on WhatsApp.

status.offlineNote: You are offline. You can still fill this in: it is saved on your phone and sent when you are back online.

done.sentBody: We received it. Continue in WhatsApp and a Scollarly adviser will answer you.
done.savedBody: It is saved on your phone and will be sent when you are online. Continue in WhatsApp now; just keep this page or the app open when you are back online.
done.whatsappBlocked: If WhatsApp did not open, tap the button above.
done.noWhatsApp: We will contact you as soon as we can.
done.couldntSave: We could not save this on your phone
done.couldntSaveHelp: Copy your details and send them to us on WhatsApp.
done.limitedRate: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
done.limitedNumber: This number has already sent several applications today. Message us on WhatsApp instead.
done.turnstilePrompt: Confirm you are human to send your application.
done.turnstileFailed: We could not confirm you are human. Please try again.
